_about: Phrasings a reviewer wants written another way, by language: what sounds natural to a native reader rather than translated or machine-written. Read by the template agents before every body and poster (template_studio.past_mistakes). Add a lesson here to teach all future drafts.

gu.why: For what the operator gains, લાભો (benefits) is the natural word; સુવિધાઓ reads like a list of facilities. The adjective then agrees with the masculine plural: મળતા.
In a list of services, name the service as a noun (…ની સુવિધા), not a bare verb; નાણાં is the natural word for money in banking.
Gujarati attaches the postposition: કમિશનથી. દ્વારા sounds translated from Hindi.
